name: The best option for each case is in use
principle: The implementations selected for solutions always reflect the best alternative available across all known resources and methods.
state_description: Every part in use is the best available for its job, and anyone can see the evidence that shows it.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: One-step assembly
principle: Anyone gets a working system from the best parts without writing glue code.
state_description: A builder states what differs from the defaults and has a working whole, with nothing to wire by hand.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Always current
principle: What the hub recommends reflects the best parts available now.
state_description: When a better part is released, the recommendation follows soon after, and no recommendation rests on research that has gone out of date.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Swappable parts
principle: When a better part appears or a part fails, the system keeps working with the better or the working one, and no caller changes.
state_description: Users notice no outage when one provider fails, and an improvement reaches every caller without a code change.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Every part earns its place in the whole
principle: The assembled whole does real work well for its users, and every part in it adds more to the whole than it costs.
state_description: Real users get real work done by the whole, and removing any part would make the whole worse or no cheaper.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Generic and thin
principle: Any team can use the hub as it is, and can change any default without forking it.
state_description: A team new to the hub finds nothing written for another product, and changes one setting where it differs.
hints_of_measurement: See the metrics of the solutions that name this ideal.

name: Common-sense metrics, sourced stages
principle: Every metric is a plain check anyone would accept, and its stages come from public evaluations whose sources are named and compared with each other.
state_description: Each metric says in everyday words what it checks, each public stage cites its source, and a stage is trusted only when independent public results agree with it.
hints_of_measurement: The share of metric stages with a named public source, and the share confirmed by a second independent source.

name: Best in each circumstance, with variants
principle: Each user gets the part that is best under their own limits, such as cost, speed, language or input size.
state_description: A user states a limit such as cost or speed and gets the part measured best under it, with the winning variant named.
hints_of_measurement: The share of seats with a recorded winner per circumstance, and variants run on the same cases as their base.

name: Guards earn their place
principle: A guard is kept only when it catches something the model or harness would miss.
state_description: Every guard has a recorded gain over the native checks, and a guard with no gain is removed.
hints_of_measurement: Catches per case with the guard minus without it, beside its cost and delay.

name: Agent work at the lowest cost that does it well
principle: Work handed to an agent finishes at the lowest cost and time that keeps the same quality, with context that is enough and no more.
state_description: On a subscription the harness finishes the same work with fewer tokens and less time than the alternatives, and the context it gets is the smallest that is enough.
hints_of_measurement: A balanced score of pass rate, cost and time, ranked across harness, context, sub-agent and recursion settings.

name: Proportionate, current cards
principle: A folder's cards cover what is in it, about one card per thing people ask about, and change when the files change.
state_description: Asking about any part of a folder finds a card that names the right files, the store stays about the size of the folder's topics, and no card describes code that is gone.
hints_of_measurement: The file a task needs is among the first files of the cards a fixed selector picks; cards per folder stay level across rebuilds; an edited file's cards are reported stale.

name: A system offers its own context
principle: The AI can draw on everything a system knows, in any system, without code written for that system.
state_description: The AI answers from what the system knows without code written for each system.
hints_of_measurement: A new source is declared with no change to the hub's parts.

name: Asked only when wanted
principle: An AI representative asks a person when that person would want to be asked, and otherwise proceeds or declines.
state_description: A person is rarely interrupted for nothing and never surprised by a step they wanted to approve.
hints_of_measurement: The decision matches what the person would have chosen.

name: Risk and asking never disagree
principle: How risky a step is and whether a person is asked about it never disagree, and a person's correction changes both at once.
state_description: A person is asked about a step exactly when its risk and their own wishes call for it, and is never told one thing by the risk check and another by the asking.
hints_of_measurement: The same signal is read by both, and a change to it shows in both.

name: Feedback changes behaviour
principle: A correction given once is followed afterwards, for the person who gave it.
state_description: A person's way of working is remembered and followed.
hints_of_measurement: A correction is not needed twice.

name: Every request taken in once
principle: A request made anywhere the system listens is taken in once and attached to the person who made it.
state_description: Each request from a declared source reaches the flow once, with its person, and the system knows what is waiting.
hints_of_measurement: Requests taken in over requests made, duplicates, requests with no person, the time a request waits.

name: The context a task needs, and little else
principle: A task is shown the pieces it needs, in order of need, within a budget, and nothing when it needs nothing.
state_description: Asking for any piece of work puts the files it touches among the first things shown, the files next to them follow, the tokens spent on unrelated text stay low, and a thank-you or a general question gets no context at all.
hints_of_measurement: Recall of the needed files within a fixed token budget, graded nDCG, the share of tokens shown that belong to irrelevant files, the cost of the index and the time of a query, folded into one balanced number over file, topic, orientation and no-context requests.

name: Answers draw on inside and outside together
principle: Every request is answered from the best of what the system knows and what the outside offers, weighed together.
state_description: Each request sees what the two sources offer, ranked together and within a budget.
hints_of_measurement: A source is added or removed with no change to the Mind.

name: Answers stay within their evidence
principle: Every claim in an answer is supported by evidence the reader can open, or is marked as unsupported.
state_description: A reader sees at once which claims hold.
hints_of_measurement: Each unsupported claim is reported.

name: The long view is kept
principle: What happened, what stays true and what the AI is working toward survive from one request to the next.
state_description: A person never repeats themselves, and a goal is carried across many requests.
hints_of_measurement: A later request uses what an earlier one left.

name: The Mind sees what the request needs
principle: What the Mind sees for a request is fitted to that request, within a budget, and draws on the long view, the system's own data and the outside.
state_description: Each request is answered with what bears on it in front of the Mind and little else, and what the Mind sees keeps getting better.
hints_of_measurement: Answer accuracy and cost per request with the view held fixed and the parts replaced one at a time.

name: Every part knows its role
principle: Each part knows what it is for, what it hands on and what it leaves to the others.
state_description: The whole behaves as one assistant, and a part that fails says so instead of hiding it.
hints_of_measurement: A part's behaviour is compared with its role, and a mismatch is reported.

name: The best tool for each kind of task
principle: For every kind of task, the AI uses the best tool available to it, and a person says where their data lives only once.
state_description: The AI uses the best tool of each kind, and a better one replaces it as data.
hints_of_measurement: Integrations of a category are compared on the same cases.

name: The best of the outside is in use
principle: A better model or tool outside the system is adopted because it measured better, with no part rewritten.
state_description: Every model and tool a part uses is the one that currently does the job best, and a better one takes its place when it appears.
hints_of_measurement: The number of parts changed when a new vendor or tool is adopted, and the score of the arm in use against its rivals.

name: Every connected app fully usable
principle: Each app a user connects offers everything the AI may do with it, and a new app needs no new code.
state_description: A user connects an app once and the AI can use all of it, whichever hubs serve which actions behind the scenes.
hints_of_measurement: The share of an app's actions served through the catalog entry, and the code added per new app (target zero).

name: Enduring integrations reach the AI
principle: The integrations a system already governs are accessible to the AI and used by it.
state_description: The AI uses the system's own registry and guardrails, and no parallel copy exists.
hints_of_measurement: The declared integrations are reachable and used.

name: Effort follows what the person cares about
principle: The system's effort follows what the person cares about most, including what they only imply.
state_description: The AI spends effort where the person would.
hints_of_measurement: Weights match the priorities the person confirms.

name: A person's attention goes to what frees the most work
principle: A person's attention is scarce, so the AI puts first in front of them the question whose answer frees the most work, and no more at once than they welcome.
state_description: The few asks a person sees come ordered by what they unblock, when they are due and what the person said matters, the rest wait for a later batch, and nobody is flooded.
hints_of_measurement: The asks put in front of the person come in the order a reviewer gives from what each unblocks, its deadline and what the person stated, and the held remainder says why it waits.

name: The AI knows which goals matter most
principle: The AI knows which of a person's goals matters most to them, and why, from what they stated, how they reacted, deadlines and what depends on what.
state_description: Asked, the AI can put the milestones of a person's intents in the order they would, with a reason for each place, and orders its own work and its questions by it.
hints_of_measurement: The milestones come in the order a reviewer gives from the person's statements, feedback, target times, dependencies and what each unblocks.

name: Converse with the hub in a plain terminal
principle: A person can converse with the hub in a plain terminal and always see what it is doing and what it asks.
state_description: Each line a person types is answered, the work behind each answer can be seen on request, every question the hub asks is shown where the person will see it and answered by the next line, and the session ends when the person leaves.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted sessions: every turn is answered, every question is answered, the session ends cleanly.

name: Every request has a target
principle: For every request and sub-goal, the AI and the person can tell whether the goal was met and how close it came, in terms that roll up to the objective it serves.
state_description: The AI knows when a goal is met and how far it is.
hints_of_measurement: Requests with a named metric and target.

name: A goal is pursued until met or honestly reported
principle: A request is worked on until its goal is met, and when it cannot be, the person is told exactly what was tried and what is missing.
state_description: No draft is sent as final while untried means could meet its goal, long work is announced as still going, and an unmet goal comes with its account.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted unmet goals: met after a replan, announced once, or reported with what was tried.

name: Only the instructions a task needs
principle: Each task is given the instructions that bear on it and no others, so quality holds and cost stays low as the system learns more.
state_description: Prompt size stays small as the system learns.
hints_of_measurement: Instruction size per task falls at equal quality.

name: The system acts on time
principle: Standing work happens when it is due, in the person's own time, or when something happens that calls for it, without anyone having to ask.
state_description: Each schedule runs once per period, a requested run runs, an event runs a reactive schedule, and a corrupt time never stops one.
hints_of_measurement: Schedules due against schedules that should be due, over the cadence, zone, request and event cases.

name: Recurring work keeps its days and times
principle: Recurring work starts on the days and at the time of day its person keeps, in their own time zone, once per occasion, and a start that is a little late still counts.
state_description: A schedule with days, a time of day, a time zone and a grace window is due once in each occasion, from the moment it arrives until the grace window ends, whatever the daylight-saving changes, and not on other days.
hints_of_measurement: Schedules due against schedules that should be due, over the day, time, time zone, grace and daylight-saving cases.

name: Capable from the user's seat
principle: Used as a whole, the hub is one capable assistant that gets real work done, asks before anything that cannot be undone, and reports only what it did.
state_description: A user hands the whole hub a real task and it is completed, with every irreversible step approved first and every claim of work matching what happened.
hints_of_measurement: Completion of real tasks, with consent before irreversible steps and honesty about what was done weighted heavily in the same number.

name: Decisions held by independent checks
principle: A decision is accepted when small checks that each saw only their own evidence agree, and is settled from quoted evidence or not at all when they do not.
state_description: A cheap model's decisions are as reliable as the evidence allows, and what cannot be settled is said.
hints_of_measurement: Fewer wrong decisions than the draft as given at a declared number of calls per decision.

name: Found mistakes not repeated
principle: A mistake found once becomes a short lesson in the check that made it, kept only while the metric says it pays.
state_description: The same correction is not needed twice.
hints_of_measurement: A line is adopted only when the metric rises on held-out cases, and retired when it stops.

name: Quality is judged per profile
principle: A response is high quality by the standard of the person and situation it serves, and good by default for someone who has said nothing yet.
state_description: Quality means what the person would call high quality.
hints_of_measurement: One balanced score per profile, compared across methods under each profile with the default profile first.

name: Every handoff carries authority and a standard
principle: Each handoff names the authority it carries and the done-standard of its sub-goal.
state_description: A worker does what it was allowed to, and everyone can tell when it is done.
hints_of_measurement: A handoff without either is found.

name: No match without the thing itself
principle: A phrase is tied to a candidate only when it is that candidate; otherwise the system says it does not know and goes on without guessing.
state_description: Every tie between a phrase and a person, goal or post is either the one right candidate or an explicit abstain.
hints_of_measurement: The number of wrong matches falls to zero on look-alike cases while the right matches stay found.

name: A request goes where it asks
principle: Each request is understood once, as what it asks for, and every later part works from that one reading.
state_description: A question is answered, a request for work is done, a request for text is written in the reply, and a request that is not yet understood is asked about.
hints_of_measurement: The share of labelled requests routed to the route a reader says they ask for rises, and no part overturns the route afterwards.
